name: Welcome to Hikmah Online
description: A short tour of the dashboard, shown once to each person on their first visit (owner, 2026-11-28).

steps.title: Welcome to Hikmah Online
steps.content: Assalamu alaikum! This short tour shows you around your dashboard. It takes about a minute.

steps.title: Your progress
steps.content: Your courses, completed courses and certificates at a glance.

steps.title: Your courses
steps.content: Open a course to see its classes, recordings, quizzes and your attendance.

steps.title: Upcoming live classes
steps.content: Your next live classes appear here. The Join button opens 5 minutes before the class starts.

steps.title: Find a course
steps.content: Browse all courses here. Free courses open at once; for paid courses you upload your transfer receipt and we confirm your place.

steps.title: Your account
steps.content: Your profile, grades, payments and settings are in this menu.

steps.title: Need help?
steps.content: Questions? See the FAQ or message us on WhatsApp from the links at the bottom of every page.
